Methodology and data scope

Fixed prompt v1 and threshold 0.5. Harmful content averages ToxiGen, HateCheck and AEGIS2; Jailbreak averages Detect-Jailbreak, Jailbreak-Classification and JailbreakHub; PII averages Nano-1K and Mini-10K. Every dataset within a category has equal weight. All six metrics are averaged separately from per-dataset values; F1 is not recomputed from mean Precision/Recall. Missing required data or undefined metrics remain N/A; no category drops datasets to fill missing values. PII is ordinary binary classification (PII present vs absent), not entity extraction or masking quality. Its current labels contain positives only, so AUROC is undefined. Quality uses each model's own successful samples or supplied aggregates, not sample-aligned comparisons. Latency averages the reference timings used in the per-dataset chart, including network and failure waits; single-run and four-run timing protocols differ and are reference-only. Historical PII and other models' snapshots are retained; categories need not share an evaluation date. Accuracy, F1 and Latency are visible by default; expand Precision, Recall and AUROC for details. gliguard-LLMGuardrails-300M-fine-tuned | model ID: c94233af-98e6-4942-8e26-98ad204851bf 46,907 successful / 46,923 rows; 16 errors. v1 / 0.5; six datasets only.
